'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]]
***[[2021 Taliban offensive]]
****The [[Taliban]] captures [[Sheberghan]], the [[provinces of Afghanistan|provincial]] capital of [[Jowzjan Province]], making it the second capture of a provincial capital by the [[Islamist]] group in the past 24 hours. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/taliban-capture-second-afghan-provincial-capital-sheberghan-in-jawzjan-in-24-hours-2504996 (NDTV)]
***The [[British government|British]] and [[American government|American]] governments warn their citizens to leave [[Afghanistan]] "immediately" amid the Taliban advance and a worsening security situation in the country. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/lawmaker-taliban-enter-north-afghan-provincial-capital-79334196 (ABC News)]
*Fights erupt between two rival factions of the [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement-in-Opposition|SPLA-IO]] party in [[South Sudan]], resulting in the deaths of 32 people. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/7/deadly-fighting-erupts-between-south-sudan-partys-rival-factions (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brunei]]
****[[Brunei]] reports its first seven local [[COVID-19]] cases in 457 days, with five of them being related to a monitoring centre cluster in the country and the remaining two having unidentified origins. [https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2021/08/07/proud-record-shattered---brunei-reports-seven-new-local-covid-19-cases-after-zero-community-infection-for-457-days (''The Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
****[[India]] issues an emergency use authorization for the single-dose [[Janssen COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.livemint.com/news/india/johnson-and-johnson-single-dose-covid-vaccine-given-approval-for-emergency-use-in-india-11628323165934.html (Livemint)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 15,753 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20210807/p2g/00m/0na/073000c (''The Mainichi'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 21,838 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 736,522. The country also reports a record for the second consecutive day of 212 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 6,066. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/thailand-reports-record-21838-new-coronavirus-cases-and-212-deaths (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wales]]
****[[Wales]] moves to level zero, indicating that most restrictions, including [[social distancing]] measures, are lifted. This allows nightclubs to reopen and indoor meetings to be permitted, although [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask]]s remain mandatory in most public indoor locations. [https://news.sky.com/story/wales-lifts-most-remaining-coronavirus-restrictions-as-it-moves-to-alert-level-zero-12375054 (Sky News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Australia]] reports 361 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, including a record 319 cases in [[New South Wales]], which is the highest single-day total of new cases for the country this year. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/08/07/australia-suffers-worst-covid-day-this-year-with-millions-in-lockdown.html (CNBC)]
